full_judgment: 61. The learned Advocate Mr. AKM Fakrul Islam, appearing on behalf of the defendant Nos. 1 and 3 in the aforesaid three admiralty suits refuted the claim and contentions of the plaintiffs making out the case that the question of accrual of maritime lien is the vital question as to the maintainability of the instant three admiralty suits under the provisions of section 4(3) of the Admiralty Court Act, 2000 and according to him the maritime lien arises as security for payment of the debt of a person, primarily against in person, and secondarily against the res since the failure of the person in discharging his debt shifts the burden of payment to the property, i.e. the vessel MV BF Glory.
